Use this page when you need a formula, a question sheet, a lab, or another way to understand a circuit. Only materials that students can use now are shown here.

## Start here

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Electronics quick reference

Formulas, units, prefixes, circuit rules, and calculator checks on two pages.

[Reference: Download the quick-reference PDF](https://andrewandrade.ca/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Quick-Reference.pdf)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Electronics handbook

A larger reference with circuit rules, logic, components, measurement, control, and calculator help.

[Reference: Open the handbook](https://andrewandrade.ca/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Reference-Handbook.html)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Basic circuit calculations

Use a schematic and the GUESS method to organize circuit calculations.

[Questions: Open the student worksheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ooJTlUf7ckOjkTP9eyJr8FyojWuOHV9-IFjZ5IoCeA/edit)

### Drawing schematics

Use consistent symbols, labels, current direction, polarity, wires, junctions, and meters.

[Reference: Open the Classroom Schematic Style Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ogHcWcRLmQbXkVMEMUDw1kDc8tvAHvPH64ncEvKSTYs/edit)

One current path, total resistance, voltage drops, power, simulation, and measurement.

[Notes and resources](../circuits/series-circuits.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Parallel circuits

Common voltage, branch current, equivalent resistance, power, and faults.

[Notes and resources](../circuits/parallel-circuits.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Series-parallel circuits

Identify groups, reduce the circuit, solve it, expand it, and check the result.

[Notes and resources](../circuits/series-parallel-circuits.qmd)
:::
